name: Image Resizer
description: Resize a photo or graphic to precise pixel dimensions for websites, forms, documents and social media. Keep the original proportions with the aspect-ratio lock, preview the output format and download the resized file. Processing takes place locally with your browser's Canvas API.
seoTitle: Image Resizer Online — Resize Photos to Exact Pixels | Nexauren
seoDescription: Resize images online to exact pixel dimensions. Keep aspect ratio, choose JPG, PNG or WebP output, and download privately in your browser for free.
steps: Choose an image from your device.
Enter the desired width and height; keep the ratio locked to avoid stretching.
Choose a format and quality, then select Resize image.

name: Image Compressor
description: Reduce the size of supported images for faster websites, sharing and uploads. Adjust output quality to balance visual detail and file size, then compare the result with the original. Canvas encoding support depends on your browser.
seoTitle: Compress Images Online — Reduce Photo File Size | Nexauren
seoDescription: Compress JPG and WebP images online by adjusting quality and checking file size savings. Free browser-based image compression.
steps: Set a quality level; lower quality usually creates a smaller lossy image.
Compress and review the output size.
Download the result if it meets your needs.

name: Image Format Converter
description: Convert an image to browser-supported PNG, JPEG or WebP output. Useful when preparing images for a website or an application that requests a specific file type. Transparency may be replaced by a solid background when exporting to JPEG.
seoTitle: Convert Images Online — PNG, JPG & WebP | Nexauren
seoDescription: Convert images between PNG, JPG and WebP in your browser. Choose an output format and quality, then download the converted image for free.
steps: Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP as the output format.
Adjust quality for JPEG or WebP if needed.
Convert and download the new file.
